nūdaka: Nudaka or Nūdaka or Nūdaka (--°)=nuda J V.401 (āsa--nūdaka).
nūtana: Nūtana (adj.) [Vedic nūtana, adj.--formation fr. adv. nū, cp. nūna. In formation cp. Sk. śvastana (of to--morrow), Lat. crastinus etc.] "지금의," 즉, 최근에, 신선한, 새로운 Dāvs IV.47.
nūna: Nūna (& nūnaṁ DhsA 164) (indecl.) [Ved. nūnaṁ=Gr. nu/n, Lat. nunc (cp. num); Goth. nu, Ger. nun, cp. E. now. See also nu] 긍정--의혹의 분사, with Pot. or Ind., viz. 1. (dubit.--interrog.) 그렇다면 ~인가, 이제, 내가 ~할까 등. (=Lat. subjunctive, hortative & dubitative) D I.155 (=Lat. num, cp. nu). 특히 대명사 yaṁ=yaṁ nūna 와 잦은 결합, 그렇다면 무엇? 내가~할까, 내가 ~하도록 (Lat. age) Sn p. 80 (yaṁ nūn'âhaṁ puccheyyaṁ 내가 물을 수 있게, 내가 묻겠소); J I.150, 255; III.393; PvA 5 (y. n. âhaṁ imassa avassayo bhaveyyaṁ=내가 그를 돕게 해주시오). -- 2. (긍정.) 분명히,, 확실히, 실로 Sn 1058 (api nūna pajaheyyuṁ); A V.194; J I.60; V.90; Pv II.924 (nuna); Miln 20; DhsA 164; PvA 95 (nuna as v. l.; text reads nanda).
nūpura: Nūpura [Sk. nūpura; Non--Aryan. Cp. Prk. ṇeura & nīdhura (nīyura)] 발에 거는 장신구, 발찌Th 2, 268; DA I.50.
